[[File:Reflections-III-fig-10.png|40px]]

A '''Defensive Shield''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type introduced in [[Reflections III]] (31 October 2001).<ref name="ref3-rules">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/reflectionsiiirules.pdf Reflections III Rules Supplement], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005192128/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/reflectionsiiirules.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Cards with the Gungan Warrior Shield icon are Defensive Shields. They are played from a pile under a [[Starting Effect]] and do not count against the 60-card deck. Replica titles of earlier Effects are a different card type; the unique and restricted rule still ties them together.

== Starting Effect limits ==
* '''2001 &ndash; Reflections III.''' Decipher's [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]] and [[Fear Is My Ally]] allowed up to 10 cards from outside the deck to be stacked face down. Each effect let its player play a Defensive Shield from that stack three times per game.<ref name="ref3-rules" />
* '''Virtual Block 4.''' The [[Players Committee]] slip sheet dated 7 December 2009 gives [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]] and [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Knowledge And Defense (V)]] room for up to 12 cards and allows four shield plays per game.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4: Expanded Universe], Players Committee, official text as of 7 December 2009, PDF pp. 4 and 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174331/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Early Set 0.''' Both pre-errata [[Virtual Set 0]] effects allowed up to 15 cards and four shield plays per game.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set], Players Committee, official text as of 1 August 2016, PDF pp. 6 and 11.</ref>
* '''November 2016 &ndash; Unlimited Shields.''' The Players Committee removed the numeric stacking cap from the two [[Virtual Set 0]] effects, [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]] and [[Knowledge And Defense (V)]]. Their new text lets players stack any number of Defensive Shields. Each effect still lets its player play a card from the stack four times per game. The announcement also drops the requirement to list Defensive Shields on the tournament decklist form.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/current-erratas-unlimited-shields/ Current Erratas & Unlimited Shields], Players Committee (16 November 2016).</ref>

The July 2018 ''Official Tournament Guide'' retains the requirement to use the same Starting Effect stack in every game played with that deck during a tournament. It also permits directors to limit excessive stacks used for stalling or showmanship. A director's limit cannot be lower than the number of distinct legal cards that can be stacked.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Star-Wars-CCG-Tournament-Guide-2.2.pdf Official Tournament Guide 2.2], Players Committee (revised July 2018), § 2.9, p. 6.</ref>
